Token Generate Event

The Token Generation Event (TGE) is a significant milestone for Yei Finance, representing the process and point in time when the project formally creates, mints, and initially distributes its native digital tokens to the public. Learn More

Role

UIUX Designer

Company

Yei Finance

Deliverable

RWD

[ Key Phases ]

Following our business strategy, we've broken down the TGE into

Three key phases

  • 1
    Complete Registration

    Register to qualify for subsequent phases.

  • 2
    Confirm Allocation

    Tokens are allocated based on distribution ratio and past contributions.

  • 3
    Claim CLO Tokens

    Claim your tokens.

  • [ Phase 1－Complete Registration ]

    To generate buzz in the community and create a sense of FOMO

    Community is key to Web3 project success. The registration phase generates buzz and anticipation, boosting project visibility and user engagement.

  • [ Phase 2－Confirm Allocation ]

    User connect their wallet address to view allocated token amount

    Allocation based on tokenomics ratios and user contributions to fairly reward the community.

    Learn more

  • [ Phase 3－Claim Tokens ]

    Guide users to lock their claimed tokens for additional bonus

    Offer additional lock-up incentives to prevent early sell-offs and maintain price stability.

[ Visual Design ]

Science fiction, Metallic sheen, Futuristic

＊ All figures are for demonstration purposes only. Actual amounts may vary.
